opening_turns.text: I removed the birth date because the cited article gives a different year.
The article is wrong. Every biography I have read says 1951.
Then please cite one of those biographies instead of reverting.
Should the infobox list the album's producer? I could not find a source.
The liner notes name him. I will add the citation tonight.
Thanks, that works for me.
Why did you merge the two sections without discussing it first?
They repeated each other. Merging was obvious.
It was not obvious to me. Please restore them until we agree.
The map in the lead is from 1998. Is there a newer one?
Commons has a 2015 version under the same licence.
Great, I will swap it in.
Your rewrite of the plot summary doubled its length.
The old summary left out the ending.
The guideline asks for under 700 words, and you are well past that.
Is the population figure from the 2020 census?
It is from a 2018 estimate. The census number is lower.
I will update it to the census figure and cite it.
Starting a discussion about the lead.
The second sentence is unsourced.
I will wait a week before removing it.
Can we add the 2019 award to the career section?
Yes, the press release is a fine source for that.
Done, thanks.
You reverted me three times today.
Because the edit had no source.
The chart needs a caption.
Agreed, I will write one.
Thanks.
This category does not apply to the article.
It does if you read the second paragraph.
I read it. It does not say that.
Should the dates use day-month-year here?
Yes, the subject is British, so day-month-year fits.
I will convert them.
